diagnosis: The bit-counting loop iterates one index beyond the legal mask range and uses a right-shift width that collapses to zero on the first iteration, so every non-zero tkeep is misclassified as the minimum frame length. Consequently the frame length register accumulates three bytes over cycles 2–4 instead of resetting at the frame boundary, producing a value of 3 when the oracle expects the new frame’s first-byte count of 1 at cycle 5.

ranking.mechanism: Clears the reported frame_len after its valid pulse so the next frame starts from zero instead of accumulating stale bytes.
Restricts the frame-start logic to cycles where no frame is currently open, preventing mid-frame tlast from incorrectly re-initializing the counter.
Ensures a new frame is only started when tlast is low, avoiding a false restart on the same cycle a frame ends.
Gates frame-start on tready so that a new frame cannot begin on a cycle where the upstream is not ready to transfer.
Gates frame-start on tvalid so that a new frame cannot begin on a cycle where the upstream has no valid data.
Requires frame_reg to be set before accepting tlast, preventing an isolated tlast from spuriously closing a non-existent frame.
